segment_boundary_enforced.title: Segment Boundary Enforced
segment_boundary_enforced.description: Default-deny PEP (stateful firewall/NACL/SG/NetworkPolicy/mesh authz) drops cross-segment traffic not on explicit allow-list.

vlan_hopping_prevention.title: VLAN Hopping Prevention
vlan_hopping_prevention.description: Access ports static + DTP disabled + unused native VLAN + BPDU Guard. N/A on cloud-VPC.

east_west_within_segment_restricted.title: East-West Within Segment Restricted
east_west_within_segment_restricted.description: Intra-segment east-west constrained by microsegmentation (host firewalls/NetworkPolicy default-deny/intra-SG isolation/mesh authz) - no flat tier.

inter_segment_traffic_filtered_by_identi.title: Inter-Segment Traffic Filtered by Identity
inter_segment_traffic_filtered_by_identi.description: Inter-segment allow rules scoped by workload identity (SG-to-SG, K8s podSelector, SPIFFE, mTLS), not source CIDR/zone alone.

inter_segment_crossings_logged.title: Inter-Segment Crossings Logged
inter_segment_crossings_logged.description: Every accepted/denied crossing captured in flow logs (VPC Flow Logs/NSG flow logs/mesh access logs) with retention and tamper-resistance.

segmentation_drift_detected.title: Segmentation Drift Detected
segmentation_drift_detected.description: Segment ACLs managed as IaC and continuously verified against baseline; out-of-band edits detected, alerted, reconciled.

private_link_for_managed_services.title: PrivateLink for Managed Services
private_link_for_managed_services.description: Managed cloud services consumed via PrivateLink/PrivateEndpoint, not public endpoints.

segment_egress_scoped.title: Segment Egress Scoped
segment_egress_scoped.description: Outbound traffic allow-listed to explicit destinations with default-deny terminator - prevents proxy-pivot via legitimately-allowed crossing hosts.
